title: Let the house burn, so the mice get some of it
odia:
ଘର ପୋଡିଯାଉ ପଛେ
ମୂଷା ପାଆନ୍ତି କେଞ୍ଚେ।
literal_meaning: Let the house burn, so long as the mice get a little of it.
meaning_odia: ଘର ପୋଡ଼ିଯାଉ ପଛେ ମୂଷାମାନେ ଟିକିଏ ପାଆନ୍ତୁ—କଥାଟିରେ ଏପରି ଜିଦ୍ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଅନ୍ୟକୁ କିଛି କଷ୍ଟ ଦେବାର ସନ୍ତୋଷ ପାଇଁ ବହୁତ ବଡ଼ କ୍ଷତିକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ମାନିନେବାର ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ ଅଛି। ଘରର ବଡ଼ କ୍ଷତି ଓ ମୂଷାଙ୍କର ଅଳ୍ପ ପ୍ରାପ୍ତି ମଧ୍ୟରେ ତଫାତ ଏହାକୁ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ କରେ।
explanation: The house can be lost, provided the mice receive even a little of what happens. Our editorial reading hears spite overriding proportion: a large loss becomes acceptable for the satisfaction of hurting a target.
usage_example: Original imagined example: In a dispute, someone is willing to ruin a shared project merely to deny a rival a small advantage. Another participant quotes the saying to expose the disproportionate cost of that spite.
cultural_context: The concessive ପଛେ pushes the burning house aside as an acceptable cost. କେଞ୍ଚେ then reduces the desired effect on the mice to a little. That imbalance between a whole house and a small retaliatory satisfaction drives the irony.

odia_summary: ଅଳ୍ପ ପ୍ରତିଶୋଧର ସନ୍ତୋଷ ପାଇଁ ବଡ଼ କ୍ଷତିକୁ ମାନିନେବାର ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ।
english_summary: Spite that accepts a great loss for a small retaliatory satisfaction.
